description: A terminator is maximal when any %elidable maximal names it, whatever a plain %elidable says, in any order. Here a plain %elidable T follows %elidable maximal T, and T stays maximal, so the text of maximal-terminator-main is rejected at T (engine §2, §4).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%elidable maximal T
%elidable T
%rule text A body [T] B
%rule body X | X B
